# eval-output-cache

> Content-addressed cache of model outputs for repeatable evaluations: canonical request keys, a bounded on-disk store and a caching LLM port Python package `trysac-eval-output-cache`, import name `eval_output_cache`, MIT licensed,
> Python >= 3.10, no runtime dependencies.
